metadata.title: Fix UI test mcp test tool not handling json objects
metadata.author: cafalchio

description: Fix UI test mcp test tool not handling json objects - Check for json type and validade json - Increase json input area to 4 rows ## 🔗 Related Issue Closes #3583 --- ## 📝 Summary The MCP tool test did not handle object-type input parameters correctly. Fields with type: "object" were sent as a raw string instead of a parsed JSON object — causing tool invocations to fail. This fix: - Renders object-type parameters as a 4-row

reviews.author: vishu-bh
reviews.body:
Thanks @cafalchio for addressing this issue. Few things to note in this change:

 1. type: "object" still accepts null, which is invalid per JSON Schema and means the UI can send a payload the schema explicitly disallows. In mcpgateway/static/admin.js#L14205, JSON.parse("null") passes the current guard because typeof null === "object" and it is not an array. This needs an explicit parsed === null check.
  2. There is no regression coverage for the new object-field path, so this bug can regress without being caught. The PR changes only mcpgateway/static/admin.js, but no test files were updated, and the existing UI test in tests/playwright/test_api_integration.py#L51 only fills input elements, not the new textarea used for object params. As written, it does not exercise JSON object entry or validation.

reviews.author: vishu-bh
reviews.body:
PR address the original object-parameter parsing gap by rendering object inputs as textareas, parsing JSON, and adding Playwright coverage for valid objects plus several invalid shapes.

LGTM 🚀

reviews.author: crivetimihai
reviews.body: Reviewed and tested. Fixed null bypass bug, improved test quality, added payload verification via request interception. All tests pass, logs clean.

commits.message:
Handle null values and added tests

Signed-off-by: cafalchio <mcafalchio@gmail.com>
commits.author: cafalchio

commits.message:
fix(ui): reject null in object parameter validation and deduplicate textarea creation

- Add parsed === null check in runToolTest() to reject JSON null values
  (typeof null === 'object' in JS, so null incorrectly passed validation)
- Combine duplicate isTextType/isObjectType branches into single condition
- Add null rejection test case to playwright test

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
refactor(tests): improve playwright test quality for object parameter validation

- Replace 20+ wait_for_timeout() calls with state-based waits (expect, wait_for_selector)
- Extract _close_and_reopen_test_modal() and _fill_and_submit_expecting_error() helpers
- Loop over invalid test cases instead of duplicating close/reopen/fill/assert 4 times
- Add documented wait for testTool() 2000ms JS debounce (enhancedDebounceDelay)
- Wait for error toast auto-dismiss to prevent stale toast bleeding into next assertion

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
test(ui): verify object parameter payload via request interception

Intercept the /rpc POST request in the happy-path test to assert that
the config parameter is sent as a parsed dict (not a raw string),
proving the JSON serialization fix actually works end-to-end.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti
